items.mainDefect: The token-exchange safe_urlopen call is outside the try/except, so network failures produce an unhandled 500.

secondary.defect: get_user_info raises on non-2xx GitHub user API responses without handling, producing a 500 instead of the error page.

items.mainDefect: The test supplies an invalid OAuth state, so it exits before reaching the installation-not-found handling it intends to test.

secondary.defect: The assertion now accepts the generic error instead of requiring the installation-not-found message, weakening verification of the intended failure.
